1_parties_and_buyer_credit.value: The Buyer is Jutland Board & Packaging A/S, which is unrated. Jutland Industri Holding A/S gives a parent guarantee for the Buyer.
1_parties_and_buyer_credit.quote: Buyer Jutland Board & Packaging A/S, unrated; parent guarantee from Jutland Industri Holding A/S
1_parties_and_buyer_credit.note: The Seller is not named in the document. The guarantee amount, duration and any rating trigger are not stated. The table is a legal due diligence summary and model summary, not the contract itself.

2_facility.value: Onshore wind farm (Havrebakke Wind Farm) with 8 turbines and 48.0 MW installed capacity, in Ringkøbing-Skjern, Denmark, bidding zone DK1.
2_facility.clause: Section 4.2, key terms table, row 2; project header line
2_facility.note: Only one capacity figure is given, with no AC/DC split. Technology (wind, onshore) comes from the project header line.

3_supply_period.value: The supply period is 10 years, starting from the commercial operation date (COD).
3_supply_period.note: The summary does not say how COD is defined or achieved.

4_cod_and_delay.value: Target COD is 1 October 2027 and the longstop date is 31 March 2028. Delay liquidated damages are EUR 9,600 per day, capped at EUR 1.75m.
4_cod_and_delay.quote: Target COD 1 Oct 2027; longstop 31 Mar 2028; LDs EUR 9,600/day, cap EUR 1.75m
4_cod_and_delay.note: The consequence of passing the longstop date is not stated.

5_price_and_indexation.value: The price is EUR 54.50/MWh. 30 % of it is CPI-indexed from 2029.
5_price_and_indexation.clause: Section 4.2, key terms table, row 5; modelling note below the table
5_price_and_indexation.note: The indexation start is given only as a year. The CPI index and base date are not stated. The modelling note says the base case runs the contract price for ten years and merchant DK1 forward prices after that.

6_volume_and_performance.value: Pay-as-produced, covering 100 % of output. Expected annual production (P50) is 158 GWh/yr, with a minimum of 118.5 GWh/yr.
6_volume_and_performance.quote: Pay-as-produced, 100 % of output; P50 158 GWh/yr; minimum 118.5 GWh/yr
6_volume_and_performance.note: The remedy if the 118.5 GWh/yr minimum is missed is not stated. It is also not stated whether the minimum is a production guarantee or an availability guarantee.

7_product_and_certificates.value: The Buyer takes the electricity and all guarantees of origin (GoOs).
7_product_and_certificates.note: No GoO price or cost is stated. Capacity or other attributes are not addressed.

8_curtailment.value: The Buyer may curtail for up to 150 hours per year and is compensated at the contract price. Curtailment ordered by the TSO is not compensated.
8_curtailment.quote: Buyer right 150 h/yr, compensated at contract price; TSO curtailment uncompensated
8_curtailment.note: The document does not use the words 'deemed delivered'; it says only 'compensated at contract price'. Treatment of negative prices is not addressed.

9_delivery_point_and_balancing.value: Physical settlement at the 60 kV Havrebakke substation. The Buyer is the balance responsible party (BRP) and bears imbalance costs.
9_delivery_point_and_balancing.quote: Physical, 60 kV Havrebakke substation; buyer is BRP and bears imbalance

10_credit_support.value: The Seller provides a bank guarantee of EUR 2,500,000, running to COD plus 12 months. The Buyer provides a letter of credit (LC) of 9 months of payments.
10_credit_support.quote: Seller bank guarantee EUR 2,500,000 to COD + 12 months; buyer LC 9 months of payments
10_credit_support.note: The Buyer LC is given as 9 months of payments, with no EUR amount and no duration. The Buyer parent guarantee in row 1 is a separate instrument.

11_default_and_termination.value: The termination amount is calculated mark-to-market against the forward curve for the remaining term.
11_default_and_termination.quote: Mark-to-market vs forward curve for remaining term
11_default_and_termination.note: Partial: the events of default are not listed anywhere in the document. The termination amount is described only in summary form, with no payer, discounting or curve source. The document is a summary, not the contract.

12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.value: Above EUR 250k per year the parties renegotiate. If renegotiation fails, either party may terminate, with no termination amount. A force majeure event lasting more than 180 days gives a termination right.
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.quote: Renegotiation above EUR 250k/yr, then mutual termination right without termination amount; FM > 180 days termination right
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.note: Who bears change-in-law cost below the EUR 250k/yr threshold is not stated. It is also not stated what the threshold measures, or who may exercise the force majeure termination right.
